camel_example: aliyun gpdb CreateAccount --region cn-hangzhou --DBInstanceId 'gp-bp***************' --AccountName testacc02 --AccountPassword Pw123456
description_en: Creates the initial account for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 创建AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的初始账号
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb create-account --db-instance-id 'gp-bp***************' --account-name testacc02 --account-password Pw123456 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccount

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including the instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The database name. The name must meet the following requirements:
It can contain only letters, digits, and underscores (_).
It must start with a letter.
It cannot exceed 63 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称，限制如下：
只能包含字母，数字和下划线。
必须以字母开头。
长度不能超过63个字符
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the initial account. The name must meet the following requirements:

It can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).
It must start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or a digit.
It cannot start with gp.
It must be 2 to 16 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
初始账号名称，限制如下：

由小写字母，数字，下划线组成。
以小写字母开头，小写字母或数字结尾。
不能以gp开头。
长度为2~16个字符
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The password of the initial account.

The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
Supported special characters: `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
初始账户的密码。

由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符其中三种及以上组成。
支持的特殊字符：`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
长度为8~32个字符
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en:
The description of the initial account. The description must meet the following requirements:
It must start with a Chinese or English letter.
It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
It can contain Chinese characters, English letters, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and digits.
It must be 2 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
初始账户的描述。要求如下：
以中文、英文字母开头。
不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
可以包含中文、英文字符、“_”、“ -”、数字。
长度为2~256个字符
parameters.name: account_description

parameters.help_en: The account type. Default value: Super, which creates a privileged account. If you set this parameter to Normal, a standard account is created
parameters.help_zh: 默认值为Super，此时创建高权限账号。当参数为Normal时，此时创建普通权限账号
parameters.name: account_type
